say:1:1320703001:0.text: I haven't heard from her in ages, and now she sends twenty pages all at once.
say:1:1320703001:0.source_cn: 我好一阵子没收到莱卡的信了，这次她一口气写了二十页信纸。

say:2:1320703002:0.text: This morning, I'm at the inn door, and there's this poor carrier pigeon wobbling like it's had too much hot spring time. It nearly crash-landed right into the steam!
say:2:1320703002:0.source_cn: 早上我站在旅馆门口，看见送信的鸽子跌跌撞撞飞过来，差点...

say:3:1320703003:0.text: I thought a hawk or something attacked it, but nope. It was just exhausted from hauling such a heavy letter!
say:3:1320703003:0.source_cn: 我还以为它在路上被野兽袭击了，结果是信件太重，把它累得够呛！

choice_prompt:4:1320703003.text: I thought a hawk or something attacked it, but nope. It was just exhausted from hauling such a heavy letter!
choice_prompt:4:1320703003.source_cn: 我还以为它在路上被野兽袭击了，结果是信件太重，把它累得够呛！

say:5:1320703004:0.text: She said she ran into some trouble. Apparently, that's why she hasn't written in so long.
say:5:1320703004:0.source_cn: 她说遇到了一点麻烦，所以一直没时间给我写信。

say:6:1320703005:0.text: Six out of twenty pages are her breaking the problem down in microscopic detail...
say:6:1320703005:0.source_cn: 二十页里面有六页都是她对那桩麻烦事的分析和总结……

say:7:1320703006:0.text: Honestly, couldn't she have sent that part to Granny Dahnie or Master Arden instead?
say:7:1320703006:0.source_cn: 真是的，这东西她写给达赫妮婆婆或者雅顿老爷子不行吗？

say:8:1320703009:0.text: Oh, and Lyca wants me to send her some gifts. She said Eironn's been showering everyone with fun trinkets, and Damian's waiting on me to contribute something too.
say:8:1320703009:0.source_cn: 莱卡还让我给寄点礼物回去，她说埃隆那家伙寄了不少有意思...

say:9:1320703010:0.text: What should I send...? Maybe I could bottle some hot spring water and have the pigeon carry that. It won't be too heavy, I'm sure.
say:9:1320703010:0.source_cn: 寄点什么好呢……如果把温泉水装在玻璃瓶里，那只信鸽能不...

choice_prompt:10:1320703010.text: What should I send...? Maybe I could bottle some hot spring water and have the pigeon carry that. It won't be too heavy, I'm sure.
choice_prompt:10:1320703010.source_cn: 寄点什么好呢……如果把温泉水装在玻璃瓶里，那只信鸽能不能带得动啊？

say:11:1320703011:1.text: Hey, there's not much here besides snow and a hot spring! What am I supposed to do—send her a snowball?
say:11:1320703011:1.source_cn: 这里除了温泉就是雪，我总不能寄一捧雪回去。

say:12:1320703013:1.text: Plus, I'm swamped. I still need to mop the floors and scrub the hot spring.
say:12:1320703013:1.source_cn: 地板还没拖，池子也还没刷，没做完的工作太多了，我抽不开身。

say:13:1320703014:0.text: Maybe we could head into town once I'm done and check out the local shops?
say:13:1320703014:0.source_cn: 要不然，我们可以一起去镇上逛逛，看看有什么适合当礼物的特产？

say:15:1320703015:0.text: Speaking of which, you need a break.

say:16:1320703016:1.text: Gerda! I thought you were out restocking.
say:16:1320703016:1.source_cn: 哎呀，格尔达！你不是去进货了吗？

say:17:1320703017:0.text: I was, but the storm blew over, so I made it back early.
say:17:1320703017:0.source_cn: 出门前看着像是要刮暴风雪，但我很幸运，没遇到恶劣天气，...

say:18:1320703018:0.text: Now, you take a break. I'll handle the chores.
say:18:1320703018:0.source_cn: 所以你去休息吧，剩下那些活交给我干。

say:20:1320703020:1.text: None of that now! I'm better at the physical stuff anyway. Besides, I've been meaning to tell you—your mopping? It's an adorable effort, but let's just say it's... not your best skill.
say:20:1320703020:1.source_cn: 行了。我比你更擅长体力活，其实我一直嫌你没把地刷干净，...

say:21:1320703021:1.text: So, take a rest. You'll thank me when your ears aren't drooping anymore.
say:21:1320703021:1.source_cn: 你偶尔也需要好好休息，休息好了，才有力气把该做的事情做好。

say:23:1320703022:1.text: Go on ahead, Lorsan! Sir Chippy will stay behind and help out with the chores!
say:23:1320703022:1.source_cn: 洛桑，你去吧，满满留下来帮忙。

say:25:1320703023:1.text: Wait, Chippy's helping?! I can't let him outshine me! Madam Gerda, I'll pitch in too!
say:25:1320703023:1.source_cn: 连满满都这么说了……那我也留下来吧。

say:26:1320703024:1.text: Just, uh... can I do the lighter stuff? Maybe customer service?
say:26:1320703024:1.source_cn: 可是我不想做体力活，我可以帮忙接待客人吗？

say:27:1320703025:1.text: *Giggle* With such an adorable little hamster on duty, business will be booming!
say:27:1320703025:1.source_cn: 哈哈，有这么可爱的仓鼠小姐在，今天的生意肯定很好。

say:30:1320703027:1.text: Lorsan, go have fun with the magister! And you better keep him safe, alright?
say:30:1320703027:1.source_cn: 洛桑，主人交给你了，要替我们照顾好主人哦。
say:30:1320703027:1.male: Lorsan, go have fun with the magister! And you better keep him safe, alright?
say:30:1320703027:1.female: Lorsan, go have fun with the magister! And you better keep her safe, alright?

say:31:1320703028:1.text: I'll make sure every single customer smiles, so make sure Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style> has a good time too!
say:31:1320703028:1.source_cn: 洛桑，我会让每位客人都开开心心，你也要让<style=...

say:32:1320703029:1.text: Deal! Thanks, Chippy and Hammie, and thank you, Gerda!
say:32:1320703029:1.source_cn: 嗯，说定了！谢谢满满和漫漫，谢谢格尔达！

say:34:1320703030:1.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, let's go hang out in the city!
say:34:1320703030:1.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, let's go hang out in the city!

choice:35:0:1.male: Is it too late to say no?
choice:35:0:1.female: Is it too late to say no?

say:41:1320703007:0.text: I fed it and let it rest by the fireplace.
say:41:1320703007:0.source_cn: 我给它喂了食，让它在暖和的炉火边歇着。

say:42:1320703008:0.text: Gotta treat it right, I don't want it reporting me to Bryon for mistreating it!
say:42:1320703008:0.source_cn: 我得对它好点，不然它回去会向布莱恩打小报告，说我欺负它！

say:1:1320704002:0.text: I'll put on a big smile for the customers!

say:0:1320705001:0.text: I've always wanted to try candied crystalberries. Let's find some!
say:0:1320705001:0.source_cn: 我一直想尝尝冰晶莓做的果脯，镇子上应该能买到吧？
say:0:1320705001:0.male: I've always wanted to try candied crystalberries. Let's find some!
say:0:1320705001:0.female: I've always wanted to try candied crystalberries. Let's find some!

say:0:1320706001:0.text: Try some of my wares, you definitely won't regret it!

say:1:1320707001:1.text: Do you have any candied crystalberries?
say:1:1320707001:1.source_cn: 有没有冰晶莓做的果脯？

say:2:1320707002:1.text: Oh, you're in luck! My family grows them. They're way bigger and sweeter than the wild ones.
say:2:1320707002:1.source_cn: 你找对人了！我家都是自己种的冰晶莓，比野外采摘的那些个...

say:3:1320707003:0.text: We even dry them over premium coal for a chewy texture with a hint of smokiness.
say:3:1320707003:0.source_cn: 我家烘干果脯用的上好煤炭，烘出来的果肉不仅口感弹软，还...

say:8:1320707008:0.text: You're not a local, are you? Around here, we say you get what you pay for.
say:8:1320707008:0.source_cn: 小哥，我看你这模样不是本地人，你知道一分钱一分货的道理吗？

say:9:1320707009:0.text: Yeah, but my wallet says I need to save for other things, too...
say:9:1320707009:0.source_cn: 知道是知道……可我还想留些钱买点别的。

choice_prompt:10:1320707009.text: Yeah, but my wallet says I need to save for other things, too...
choice_prompt:10:1320707009.source_cn: 知道是知道……可我还想留些钱买点别的。

say:11:1320707010:1.text: Feel free to shop around, but you'll see mine are the best.
say:11:1320707010:1.source_cn: 你们先去别家尝尝看嘛，尝了就知道还是我家的最好吃。

say:12:1320707012:1.text: Take your time. I've got deliveries to make anyway.
say:12:1320707012:1.source_cn: 反正我是不讲价的，你们先慢慢琢磨着吧，我要去镇外送货。

say:13:1320707013:1.text: Deliveries? Well, I know this saying: "Not even the wind whispers without purpose."
say:13:1320707013:1.source_cn: 送货？老板娘，我知道雪松镇有一句俚语：唯有死亡免费。

say:14:1320707014:1.text: How about this; I help with your deliveries, and you knock some off the price?
say:14:1320707014:1.source_cn: 你看这样行不行，我去帮你送货，你能不能便宜点卖给我？

say:15:1320707015:1.text: Hmm... maybe. But first, sort out that box over there. Some candied fruit got mixed into it earlier.
say:15:1320707015:1.source_cn: 还挺热心呀，那你先把那一箱乱七八糟的东西收拾好，刚才有...

say:16:1320707016:0.text: You're so kind and beautiful, surely you wouldn't make me work for free?
say:16:1320707016:0.source_cn: 老板娘，你美丽又温柔，肯定不会让我白干活吧？

say:17:1320707017:0.text: Flattery's cute, but it doesn't work on me. If you want a deal, you've gotta earn it.
say:17:1320707017:0.source_cn: 年轻人，嘴真甜呢，但我可没这么容易上当，你想从我这里捞...

say:18:1320707018:1.text: Ahh, fine! For the sake of my poor wallet, I'll do the best sorting job ever!
say:18:1320707018:1.source_cn: 好吧，为了省钱，我会努力展现出诚意的！

choice_prompt:19:1320707018.text: Ahh, fine! For the sake of my poor wallet, I'll do the best sorting job ever!
choice_prompt:19:1320707018.source_cn: 好吧，为了省钱，我会努力展现出诚意的！

say:20:1320707019:0.female: Miss, could you lend a hand too? To be frank, this big box might be difficult for a single person to sort through.

choice_prompt:21:1320707019.source_cn: <male>先生</male><female>女士</female>，麻烦你也搭把手，其实我正愁一个人搞不定这些呢。
choice_prompt:21:1320707019.male: Mister, could you lend a hand too? To be frank, this big box might be difficult for a single person to sort through.
choice_prompt:21:1320707019.female: Miss, could you lend a hand too? To be frank, this big box might be difficult for a single person to sort through.

say:22:1320707020:0.text: If you help me, I might be in a good enough mood to do you a favor.
say:22:1320707020:0.source_cn: 你帮我解决了麻烦，我心情一好，说不定什么都答应了。
say:22:1320707020:0.male: If you help me, I might be in a good enough mood to do you a favor.
say:22:1320707020:0.female: If you help me, I might be in a good enough mood to do you a favor.

say:23:1320707025:1.text: Alright, you two, enough chit-chat. Let's see what you can do!
say:23:1320707025:1.source_cn: 二位，先干活吧。我很期待你们的表现哦。

choice:21:0:1.source_cn: 前提是你愿意帮洛桑免单

say:25:1320707021:0.text: Really? I couldn't possibly trouble you like this...
say:25:1320707021:0.male: Really? I couldn't possibly trouble you like this...
say:25:1320707021:0.female: Really? I couldn't possibly trouble you like this...

choice_prompt:26:1320707021.text: Really? I couldn't possibly trouble you like this...
choice_prompt:26:1320707021.male: Really? I couldn't possibly trouble you like this...
choice_prompt:26:1320707021.female: Really? I couldn't possibly trouble you like this...

say:27:1320707022:0.text: That's exactly why! I've already asked too much of you so many times...
say:27:1320707022:0.source_cn: 正因为每次都麻烦你，所以才——
say:27:1320707022:0.male: That's exactly why! I've already asked too much of you so many times...
say:27:1320707022:0.female: That's exactly why! I've already asked too much of you so many times...

say:28:1320707023:0.text: Ahh... I'm terrible at this polite stuff. I should just focus on figuring out how to properly thank you.
say:28:1320707023:0.source_cn: 哎呀……我实在不擅长说客套话，我还是应该好好想想怎么报答你。
say:28:1320707023:0.male: Ahh... I'm terrible at this polite stuff. I should just focus on figuring out how to properly thank you.
say:28:1320707023:0.female: Ahh... I'm terrible at this polite stuff. I should just focus on figuring out how to properly thank you.

say:29:1320707024:1.text: Of course! I'll rack my brains and think of something great, for sure!
say:29:1320707024:1.source_cn: 嗯，我肯定绞尽脑汁，使劲地想！
say:29:1320707024:1.male: Of course! I'll rack my brains and think of something great, for sure!
say:29:1320707024:1.female: Of course! I'll rack my brains and think of something great, for sure!

choice:26:1:2.text: I'm sure you'll repay me somehow!
choice:26:1:2.male: I'm sure you'll repay me somehow!
choice:26:1:2.female: I'm sure you'll repay me somehow!

choice:10:0:1.text: Can't you lower the price, ma'am?
choice:10:0:1.male: Can't you lower the price, ma'am?
choice:10:0:1.female: Can't you lower the price, ma'am?

choice:10:1:2.text: Just buy it if you like it.
choice:10:1:2.male: Just buy it if you like it.
choice:10:1:2.female: Just buy it if you like it.

say:1:1320708001:0.text: Look at that, <style="stress"><player_name></style>! Teamwork makes the dream work! We finished in no time.
say:1:1320708001:0.male: Look at that, <style="stress"><player_name></style>! Teamwork makes the dream work! We finished in no time.
say:1:1320708001:0.female: Look at that, <style="stress"><player_name></style>! Teamwork makes the dream work! We finished in no time.

say:2:1320708002:1.text: Great job! But you don't think this measly work is enough to deserve something in return, do you?
say:2:1320708002:1.source_cn: 做得不错，但我这里永远不降价！

say:4:1320708004:1.text: Just kidding! You've been so helpful. This pack of candied fruit is on the house.
say:4:1320708004:1.source_cn: 不过……看在你们这么勤快的份上，这包果脯干脆送给你好了。

say:5:1320708005:1.text: Cedartown is a welcoming place, we don't let guests leave unhappy!
say:5:1320708005:1.source_cn: 我们雪松镇是好客的地方，不会让客人伤心离去的。

say:6:1320708006:1.text: Thank you! Since you've been so generous, I'll also help with your delivery! Where's it going?
say:6:1320708006:1.source_cn: 谢谢你！收了你的东西，我更得帮你干活了，你的货物要送哪去？

say:7:1320708007:1.text: To Fedor, the shepherd. He ordered a crate of crystalberries. You'll see his pen right outside town.
say:7:1320708007:1.source_cn: 费多尔，他是个牧羊人，找我订购了一箱冰晶莓。你出了镇子...

say:8:1320708008:1.text: Got it, I'll head out now!

say:0:1320709001:0.source_cn: 我们把货物送给那位叫费多尔的牧羊人吧。

say:1:1320711001:0.text: We're here on behalf of Vannie to deliver what you ordered. Can you check the goods?
say:1:1320711001:0.source_cn: 我们帮瓦妮小姐把您要的东西送来了，请您清点。

say:2:1320711002:0.text: Oh, and here I thought the dwarf finally arrived... It's just the crystalberries I asked for. I almost forgot! Thanks a bunch.
say:2:1320711002:0.source_cn: 还以为是之前答应上门的矮人们终于来了。原来是之前订购的...

say:3:1320711003:1.text: It's freezing out there, you must've had a tough trip. Here, take this wool scarf my wife made as a thank-you.
say:3:1320711003:1.source_cn: 大冷天的，你们跑一趟辛苦了，这是我老婆用羊毛织的小玩意...

say:4:1320711004:1.text: Wow, that's so kind of you! By the way, you mentioned you're waiting for someone?
say:4:1320711004:1.source_cn: 哎呀呀，太客气了！你说在等矮人？

say:5:1320711005:1.text: Ah, yes. Those pesky gruglins have wrecked my sheep pen a few times now. A dwarf in town promised to help me fix it.
say:5:1320711005:1.source_cn: 啊，我的羊圈被讨厌的咕布林弄坏好几次，镇上那些矮人知道...

say:6:1320711006:1.text: Sounds pretty generous! That makes this bitter winter feel a lot warmer.
say:6:1320711006:1.source_cn: 他们真是善良热心啊，让这个难捱的冬天都暖和了不少。

say:7:1320711007:1.text: Well... generous might not be the right word. He just seems to enjoy solving problems.
say:7:1320711007:1.source_cn: 嗯……与其说热心，他们似乎只是享受解决问题的过程。

say:8:1320711008:1.text: Be it my pen or someone's pigsty, he's always eager to pitch in. Either way, I'm grateful.
say:8:1320711008:1.source_cn: 不管是我家羊圈的问题，还是别人家猪圈的问题。不管怎样，...

say:10:1320711009:0.text: Sorry to keep you waiting! The snow's awful, the roads are a mess!
say:10:1320711009:0.source_cn: 嘿！久等了！雪太厚了，路真难走啊。

say:1:1320712001:0.text: Finally! Your friends said you've got a way to stop those gruglins for good.
say:1:1320712001:0.source_cn: 哦，你可算来了！你的族人说有办法解决咕布林破坏栅栏的问...

say:2:1320712002:1.text: Ugh, those blabbermouths! I only just came up with the idea, and Haldor's already told you?
say:2:1320712002:1.source_cn: 那帮家伙的嘴挺快啊，我才想出新点子，老约恩这就告诉你了？

say:3:1320712003:1.text: Anyway, meet Ironchomp. You're gonna love it!
say:3:1320712003:1.source_cn: 我马上请小铁牙出来，你们瞧好吧。

say:5:1320712005:1.text: It's the name of the protective fence I designed!

say:6:1320712006:1.text: That... well, you've given it quite the name.
say:6:1320712006:1.source_cn: 这……好吧，你给它取了个好名字呢。

say:7:1320712007:1.text: Of course! If it works, it'll stop the gruglins cold and revolutionize Cedartown's security!
say:7:1320712007:1.source_cn: 那可不！要是小铁牙能彻底阻止咕布林，它以后也能为雪松镇...

say:8:1320712008:1.text: It'll take a bit to set up, though—it should be done by dawn. Why don't you keep me company?
say:8:1320712008:1.source_cn: 安装小铁牙需要点时间，你们等等吧，不会太久的，明早天亮...

say:11:1320712010:1.text: What's the rush? You got plans?

choice_prompt:12:1320712010.text: What's the rush? You got plans?

say:14:1320712012:1.text: Kinda... I need to pick out some gifts for everyone back home.
say:14:1320712012:1.source_cn: 倒不是什么要紧事，我在帮家人们挑礼物。

say:15:1320712013:1.text: And I can't be out too long, there's work waiting for me at the inn.
say:15:1320712013:1.source_cn: 可我不能在外头耽误太久，旅馆那边还有活儿等着我。

say:16:1320712015:1.text: If it's gifts you're after, you can't skip Cedartown's specialty: <style="highlight">canned balm herring</style>!
say:16:1320712015:1.source_cn: 说到礼物，千万不能错过镇子上的名产——<style=h...

say:17:1320712016:1.text: It's the best snack with drinks you'll find. Trust me, it'll be a hit with anyone!
say:17:1320712016:1.source_cn: 雪松镇再也找不到比它更带劲的下酒菜了，相信我，你们一定...

say:18:1320712017:1.text: Fish, huh? Master Arden and Granny Dahnie would definitely go for that. Where do I get some?
say:18:1320712017:1.source_cn: 下酒菜啊……雅顿老师和达赫妮婆婆应该会喜欢。哪里能买到？

say:19:1320712018:1.text: There's this awesome spot I always go to. Tell 'em I sent you, and you might even get a little discount!
say:19:1320712018:1.source_cn: 镇上我常去的那家餐馆就能买到。报我的名字，兴许老板娘还...

say:20:1320712019:1.text: That'll be our next stop. Thanks!

say:23:1320712014:1.text: Oho! I've got a suggestion for you!
say:23:1320712014:1.source_cn: 礼物呀，我知道一个好东西！

say:0:1320713001:0.text: Come on in! There are plenty of seats available.

say:1:1320714001:1.text: Madam, I'm looking for a gift. My dwarf friend recommended—
say:1:1320714001:1.source_cn: 老板娘，我在物色礼物，我的矮人朋友向我推荐了——

say:2:1320714002:0.text: Oh, a dwarf, huh? Let me guess, they recommended canned fish?
say:2:1320714002:0.source_cn: 哦，矮人呐，他们肯定推荐了鱼罐头。

say:3:1320714003:1.source_cn: 对对，好像是香脂腓做的罐头。

say:4:1320714004:1.text: Aha. They tried it once and instantly got hooked! They won't stop raving about it!
say:4:1320714004:1.source_cn: 嗯，他们刚来镇上的那天看见我在吃，立马就被那种味道吸引...

say:5:1320714005:1.text: I'll take two cans! Let's try some first, <style="stress"><player_name></style>, before we share it with Lyca and the others.
say:5:1320714005:1.male: I'll take two cans! Let's try some first, <style="stress"><player_name></style>, before we share it with Lyca and the others.
say:5:1320714005:1.female: I'll take two cans! Let's try some first, <style="stress"><player_name></style>, before we share it with Lyca and the others.

say:6:1320714006:0.text: Oh dear, unfortunately they're all out of stock. The dwarves cleaned me out!
say:6:1320714006:0.source_cn: 没货了，库存都被矮人们吃完了。

say:7:1320714007:1.text: When will you restock? We'll be in town for a while.
say:7:1320714007:1.source_cn: 什么时候补货呢？我们还会在镇上待一阵子。

say:8:1320714008:1.text: Balsam herring is rare. With the Snowspire Festival and all the skilled anglers visiting, it's been tough catching enough of them.
say:8:1320714008:1.source_cn: 香脂腓是一种很稀有的鱼，最近举办冬日祭典，来了许多厉害...

say:9:1320714009:1.text: Madam... the loveliest madam in the north... isn't there anything you can do? I'll do anything!
say:9:1320714009:1.source_cn: 老板娘……美丽的老板娘……真的不能再想想办法吗？我什么...

say:10:1320714010:0.text: Well, since you asked so sweetly...

say:11:1320714011:1.text: To be honest, I've got two cans set aside for myself.
say:11:1320714011:1.source_cn: 不瞒你说，我还偷偷存了两罐呢，准备留着自己吃。

say:12:1320714012:1.text: I knew you were my hero!
say:12:1320714012:1.source_cn: 老板娘，我就知道您是好人！

say:13:1320714013:1.text: But don't get me wrong, they're not for sale! If you want them, you'll need to trade me a <style="highlight">dream eel</style>.
say:13:1320714013:1.source_cn: 丑话说在前面。这鱼罐头不能随便卖给你们。你们得用<st...

say:14:1320714014:1.text: I'm working on a new dish for my menu, but I'm too scared to go to those creepy places to fish for them myself. You guys look like seasoned adventurers, so it should be easy for you!
say:14:1320714014:1.source_cn: 我正在开发新菜单，需要用到魇鳗，但我又不敢去阴森森的地...

say:15:1320714015:1.text: I mean, I guess you could call me an adventurer... but fishing isn't exactly my forte.
say:15:1320714015:1.source_cn: 或许我勉强算是经验丰富的冒险者……但我可不擅长钓鱼啊。

say:16:1320714016:1.text: Whenever I camped with Bryon, I always scared the fish away before they even bit. We'd end up starving!
say:16:1320714016:1.source_cn: 以前和布莱恩在外面露营，我每次都在鱼咬钩之前就把它们吓...

choice_prompt:17:1320714016.text: Whenever I camped with Bryon, I always scared the fish away before they even bit. We'd end up starving!
choice_prompt:17:1320714016.source_cn: 以前和布莱恩在外面露营，我每次都在鱼咬钩之前就把它们吓走，最后我俩不得不饿了一宿。

say:18:1320714017:1.text: Oh? Since when did you know how to fish? I'd love to see it!
say:18:1320714017:1.source_cn: 你什么时候成了个钓鱼能手？那可得让我好好见识一下！
say:18:1320714017:1.male: Oh? Since when did you know how to fish? I'd love to see it!
say:18:1320714017:1.female: Oh? Since when did you know how to fish? I'd love to see it!

say:19:1320714019:0.text: You're really pumped! You can catch dream eels in <style="highlight">Echoing Glen</style>. Good luck, I'll be waiting!

choice:17:0:1.text: Guess it's up to me again...
choice:17:0:1.male: Guess it's up to me again...
choice:17:0:1.female: Guess it's up to me again...

say:21:1320714018:1.text: Whoa! If I tag along, maybe I'll pick up a few tips. Bryon will be so impressed when I get back!
say:21:1320714018:1.source_cn: 哇，我得跟着你好好学一学，回去以后让布莱恩刮目相看！
say:21:1320714018:1.male: Whoa! If I tag along, maybe I'll pick up a few tips. Bryon will be so impressed when I get back!
say:21:1320714018:1.female: Whoa! If I tag along, maybe I'll pick up a few tips. Bryon will be so impressed when I get back!

choice:17:1:2.text: Don't worry, I'm a fishing expert.
choice:17:1:2.male: Don't worry, I'm a fishing expert.
choice:17:1:2.female: Don't worry, I'm a fishing expert.

say:1:1320715001:0.text: This place is so eerie... no wonder she didn't want to come here.
say:1:1320715001:0.source_cn: 这地方确实阴森森的……难怪老板娘说害怕。
say:1:1320715001:0.male: This place is so eerie... no wonder she didn't want to come here.
say:1:1320715001:0.female: This place is so eerie... no wonder she didn't want to come here.

say:2:1320715002:1.text: Do you think something might jump out at us?
say:2:1320715002:1.source_cn: 你说，一会儿会不会有什么东西突然出现……
say:2:1320715002:1.male: Do you think something might jump out at us?
say:2:1320715002:1.female: Do you think something might jump out at us?

choice_prompt:3:1320715002.text: Do you think something might jump out at us?
choice_prompt:3:1320715002.source_cn: 你说，一会儿会不会有什么东西突然出现……
choice_prompt:3:1320715002.male: Do you think something might jump out at us?
choice_prompt:3:1320715002.female: Do you think something might jump out at us?

say:4:1320715003:1.text: *Ahem* True... Nothing's scarier than the corruption in the Dark Forest.
say:4:1320715003:1.source_cn: 咳……说的也是，再怎么可怕，也比不上遭遇腐化的薄暮丛林。
say:4:1320715003:1.male: *Ahem* True... Nothing's scarier than the corruption in the Dark Forest.
say:4:1320715003:1.female: *Ahem* True... Nothing's scarier than the corruption in the Dark Forest.

say:5:1320715009:1.text: Anyway, let's focus on fishing. I heard dream eels are ferocious, so stay sharp.
say:5:1320715009:1.source_cn: 我们还是先钓鱼吧。我听说魇鳗很凶猛，小心点。
say:5:1320715009:1.male: Anyway, let's focus on fishing. I heard dream eels are ferocious, so stay sharp.
say:5:1320715009:1.female: Anyway, let's focus on fishing. I heard dream eels are ferocious, so stay sharp.

say:8:1320715005:1.text: Wait... there's nothing there. You were messing with me!
say:8:1320715005:1.source_cn: 什、什么都没有啊！你是不是故意吓我？
say:8:1320715005:1.male: Wait... there's nothing there. You were messing with me!
say:8:1320715005:1.female: Wait... there's nothing there. You were messing with me!

say:9:1320715006:1.text: You know that if I faint, you'd be the one who has to carry me back!
say:9:1320715006:1.source_cn: 要是我被吓晕了，你还得把我背回去……
say:9:1320715006:1.male: You know that if I faint, you'd be the one who has to carry me back!
say:9:1320715006:1.female: You know that if I faint, you'd be the one who has to carry me back!

choice_prompt:10:1320715006.text: You know that if I faint, you'd be the one who has to carry me back!
choice_prompt:10:1320715006.source_cn: 要是我被吓晕了，你还得把我背回去……
choice_prompt:10:1320715006.male: You know that if I faint, you'd be the one who has to carry me back!
choice_prompt:10:1320715006.female: You know that if I faint, you'd be the one who has to carry me back!

say:11:1320715007:1.text: Heh, I knew you'd never leave me behind!
say:11:1320715007:1.source_cn: 嘿嘿，我就知道你不会扔下我不管。
say:11:1320715007:1.male: Heh, I knew you'd never leave me behind!
say:11:1320715007:1.female: Heh, I knew you'd never leave me behind!

say:12:1320715008:1.text: W-what?! Magister, you're so cruel... I should've learned from you and stopped getting scammed on all those trips on my way here.
say:12:1320715008:1.source_cn: 好狠的心……我早该向你学学，就不至于旅途中一次次被骗钱。
say:12:1320715008:1.male: W-what?! Magister, you're so cruel... I should've learned from you and stopped getting scammed on all those trips on my way here.
say:12:1320715008:1.female: W-what?! Magister, you're so cruel... I should've learned from you and stopped getting scammed on all those trips on my way here.

choice:10:1:2.text: I'd just leave you behind instead.
choice:10:1:2.male: I'd just leave you behind instead.
choice:10:1:2.female: I'd just leave you behind instead.

say:0:1320716001:0.text: Whoa, you really caught one! Let's head back.
say:0:1320716001:0.source_cn: 厉害！这么快就钓上来了。我们回雪松镇吧。
say:0:1320716001:0.male: Whoa, you really caught one! Let's head back.
say:0:1320716001:0.female: Whoa, you really caught one! Let's head back.

say:1:1320717001:1.text: Hey, you didn't see any dancing chairs, talking stools, or glasses trying to play music, right?
say:1:1320717001:1.source_cn: 先告诉我，你们应该没看见跳舞的凳子，说话的椅子，或者是...

say:2:1320717002:1.text: Uh... why would we see those?
say:2:1320717002:1.source_cn: 呃……我们应该看见这些东西吗？

say:3:1320717003:0.text: If a dream eel bites you, you'll see all sorts of things! Their venom is hallucinogenic.
say:3:1320717003:0.source_cn: 被魇鳗咬上一口，看见什么都不奇怪。那玩意的牙齿上有毒素...

say:4:1320717004:1.text: ...Next time, maybe give us a heads-up about that?!
say:4:1320717004:1.source_cn: 要不……这种话下次还是提前点说？

say:5:1320717005:1.text: Ahaha! Sorry, it completely slipped my mind!
say:5:1320717005:1.source_cn: 啊哈哈哈！对不住，我忘了嘛。

say:6:1320717006:0.text: Alright, as an apology, these two cans are yours!
say:6:1320717006:0.source_cn: 好吧，为表歉意，这两罐吃的送你们了。

say:7:1320717007:1.text: Madam, you're too kind. I can forgive your tiny bit of forgetfulness; after all, no one's perfect.
say:7:1320717007:1.source_cn: 老板娘，您这么善解人意，我完全可以忽略您这一点小小的健...

say:8:1320717008:1.text: Anyway, I'm so glad so many people have been coming to buy my canned fish lately.
say:8:1320717008:1.source_cn: 最近这么多人爱上了我做的香脂腓罐头，我非常高兴！

say:9:1320717009:1.text: "Lately"? Does that mean the townsfolk aren't fans?
say:9:1320717009:1.source_cn: “最近”？难道雪松镇的人不喜欢这种罐头吗？

say:10:1320717010:1.text: This recipe was passed down from my grandmother, it was a big hit in her time.
say:10:1320717010:1.source_cn: 这是我外祖母传给我的秘方，是他们那一辈人最喜欢的食物。

say:11:1320717011:1.text: But the younger crowd often says it's... well, try it for yourselves and let me know what you think!
say:11:1320717011:1.source_cn: 年轻人都说它太……总之，你们快打开尝尝，我想听你们亲自点评！

narration:13:1320717013:0.text: Lorsan opens the can, and an oppressive odor assaults your senses like a beastly roar—so intense it almost knocks you out. You barely manage to keep your senses intact.
narration:13:1320717013:0.source_cn: 洛桑打开罐头，令人两眼一黑的猛烈味道直冲头顶！你们差点...
narration:13:1320717013:0.male: Lorsan opens the can, and an oppressive odor assaults your senses like a beastly roar—so intense it almost knocks you out. You barely manage to keep your senses intact.
narration:13:1320717013:0.female: Lorsan opens the can, and an oppressive odor assaults your senses like a beastly roar—so intense it almost knocks you out. You barely manage to keep your senses intact.

say:14:1320717014:1.source_cn: 这、这可真是——难闻……哦不，是难忘！

say:15:1320717015:1.text: It's an unforgettable scent, right? The smell will etch itself into your mind, and the taste? One bite, and it'll carve itself into your soul!
say:15:1320717015:1.source_cn: 没错！它的味道会刻入你的大脑，吃一口吧，让它的味道刻入...

say:16:1320717016:1.text: Taste... it? Are you sure I'll survive eating this...?
say:16:1320717016:1.source_cn: 吃？吃下去了……还、还能活吗？

say:17:1320717017:1.text: Don't worry, Bunny Boy. You won't die from sheer joy after just one bite of canned fish!
say:17:1320717017:1.source_cn: 放心吧兔子，你不会因为吃了一口罐头而幸福到死去的！

choice_prompt:21:1320717019.source_cn: <style=stress><player_name></style>……这东西和我想象中不太一样……

say:22:1320717020:1.text: What do I do... I don't want to hurt her feelings...
say:22:1320717020:1.source_cn: 怎么办……我不想破坏老板娘的一番好意……
say:22:1320717020:1.male: What do I do... I don't want to hurt her feelings...
say:22:1320717020:1.female: What do I do... I don't want to hurt her feelings...

choice_prompt:23:1320717020.source_cn: 怎么办……我不想破坏老板娘的一番好意……
choice_prompt:23:1320717020.male: What do I do... I don't want to hurt her feelings...
choice_prompt:23:1320717020.female: What do I do... I don't want to hurt her feelings...

say:24:1320717021:1.text: The truth? Like, "Hey, this smells worse than ten seasons' worth of hornleaf bear dung piled up in a cave"?
say:24:1320717021:1.source_cn: 实话要怎么说？告诉她这东西的味道简直比叶角熊发酵了十个...
say:24:1320717021:1.male: The truth? Like, "Hey, this smells worse than ten seasons' worth of hornleaf bear dung piled up in a cave"?
say:24:1320717021:1.female: The truth? Like, "Hey, this smells worse than ten seasons' worth of hornleaf bear dung piled up in a cave"?

say:25:1320717022:0.text: I can't say that when she's looking at me all happy!
say:25:1320717022:0.male: I can't say that when she's looking at me all happy!
say:25:1320717022:0.female: I can't say that when she's looking at me all happy!

narration:26:1320717025:1.male: Lorsan shuts his eyes and stabs a chunk of the greenish-black fish. With trembling determination, he takes a bite... You watch as his face slowly turns the same color as the fish.
narration:26:1320717025:1.female: Lorsan shuts his eyes and stabs a chunk of the greenish-black fish. With trembling determination, he takes a bite... You watch as his face slowly turns the same color as the fish.

say:31:1320717028:1.text: Why do I get the feeling he's about to faint?
say:31:1320717028:1.source_cn: 我怎么感觉他快要晕倒了？
say:31:1320717028:1.male: Why do I get the feeling he's about to faint?
say:31:1320717028:1.female: Why do I get the feeling he's about to faint?

say:32:1320717030:1.text: Why don't you take him to the Floral Ruins for some fresh air?
say:32:1320717030:1.source_cn: 遗迹花海附近的空气很清新，赶紧去带他透透气吧。
say:32:1320717030:1.male: Why don't you take him to the Floral Ruins for some fresh air?
say:32:1320717030:1.female: Why don't you take him to the Floral Ruins for some fresh air?

say:34:1320717029:1.text: Poor guy... He's pushing himself too hard.
say:34:1320717029:1.source_cn: 善良的傻孩子……他太勉强自己了。
say:34:1320717029:1.male: Poor guy... He's pushing himself too hard.
say:34:1320717029:1.female: Poor guy... He's pushing himself too hard.

say:35:1320717023:1.text: You're right... Master Arden always says, "What doesn't kill you builds character!"
say:35:1320717023:1.source_cn: 没……没错……你是对的，雅顿老爷子也说过，要勇于探索！
say:35:1320717023:1.male: You're right... Master Arden always says, "What doesn't kill you builds character!"
say:35:1320717023:1.female: You're right... Master Arden always says, "What doesn't kill you builds character!"

say:36:1320717024:1.text: Alright, prepare yourself! You're about to witness the bravest version of me ever!
say:36:1320717024:1.source_cn: 好吧！今天让你看看最有勇气的洛桑！
say:36:1320717024:1.male: Alright, prepare yourself! You're about to witness the bravest version of me ever!
say:36:1320717024:1.female: Alright, prepare yourself! You're about to witness the bravest version of me ever!

choice:23:1:2.text: You should at least try it.
choice:23:1:2.male: You should at least try it.
choice:23:1:2.female: You should at least try it.

choice:21:0:1.text: You look like you're about to hurl.
choice:21:0:1.male: You look like you're about to hurl.
choice:21:0:1.female: You look like you're about to hurl.

say:3:1320719002:1.text: It's smashed to bits... like a cookie someone sat on!
say:3:1320719002:1.source_cn: 被那怪物啄坏了，碎得像是一块摔烂的曲奇饼。
say:3:1320719002:1.male: It's smashed to bits... like a cookie someone sat on!
say:3:1320719002:1.female: It's smashed to bits... like a cookie someone sat on!

say:4:1320719003:1.text: This was a gift from Master Arden... Now, it's only good for firewood.
say:4:1320719003:1.source_cn: 这可是雅顿老爷子送我的礼物……这下子它只能当柴火了。
say:4:1320719003:1.male: This was a gift from Master Arden... Now, it's only good for firewood.
say:4:1320719003:1.female: This was a gift from Master Arden... Now, it's only good for firewood.

say:7:1320719004:0.text: Whoa! It looks good as new; let me try it out.

say:7:1320719004:0.female: Whoa! It looks good as new; let me try it out.

say:27:1320744022:1.male: But before the next farewell, whenever it may come, I hope we'll meet again.
say:27:1320744022:1.female: But before the next farewell, whenever it may come, I hope we'll meet again.

say:28:1320744023:1.source_cn: 要常来啊，我会等着你的！

say:30:1320744021:1.text: I understand; you're Magister Merlin, after all! People must be lining up to hang out with you.
say:30:1320744021:1.source_cn: 我知道，毕竟你是梅林啊。
say:30:1320744021:1.male: I understand; you're Magister Merlin, after all! People must be lining up to hang out with you.
say:30:1320744021:1.female: I understand; you're Magister Merlin, after all! People must be lining up to hang out with you.

say:4:1320718001:1.text: Phew... thanks. I feel loads better now.
say:4:1320718001:1.source_cn: 呼……谢谢你，我感觉好多了。
say:4:1320718001:1.male: Phew... thanks. I feel loads better now.
say:4:1320718001:1.female: Phew... thanks. I feel loads better now.

say:5:1320718002:1.text: That flavor... it was terrifying, even worse than a Hypogean. For a moment, I swear I saw Misarte...
say:5:1320718002:1.source_cn: 真是可怕的味道……比恶魔还吓人。刚才，我迷迷糊糊的，仿...
say:5:1320718002:1.male: That flavor... it was terrifying, even worse than a Hypogean. For a moment, I swear I saw Misarte...
say:5:1320718002:1.female: That flavor... it was terrifying, even worse than a Hypogean. For a moment, I swear I saw Misarte...

say:6:1320718003:0.text: She was saying something, but my head was spinning so much I couldn't make out a word... What kind of Windwhisperer am I, missing a divine message?!
say:6:1320718003:0.source_cn: 她好像和我说话了，但我脑袋发晕，什么都没听清……身为风...
say:6:1320718003:0.male: She was saying something, but my head was spinning so much I couldn't make out a word... What kind of Windwhisperer am I, missing a divine message?!
say:6:1320718003:0.female: She was saying something, but my head was spinning so much I couldn't make out a word... What kind of Windwhisperer am I, missing a divine message?!

choice_prompt:7:1320718003.text: She was saying something, but my head was spinning so much I couldn't make out a word... What kind of Windwhisperer am I, missing a divine message?!
choice_prompt:7:1320718003.source_cn: 她好像和我说话了，但我脑袋发晕，什么都没听清……身为风语者居然没听清神谕，这也太丢人了！
choice_prompt:7:1320718003.male: She was saying something, but my head was spinning so much I couldn't make out a word... What kind of Windwhisperer am I, missing a divine message?!
choice_prompt:7:1320718003.female: She was saying something, but my head was spinning so much I couldn't make out a word... What kind of Windwhisperer am I, missing a divine message?!

say:8:1320718004:1.text: If that's the case, I'm totally rubbing it in Eironn's face!
say:8:1320718004:1.source_cn: 如果是这样，我可得向埃隆好好炫耀一番！
say:8:1320718004:1.male: If that's the case, I'm totally rubbing it in Eironn's face!
say:8:1320718004:1.female: If that's the case, I'm totally rubbing it in Eironn's face!

say:9:1320718006:1.text: Ah... the breeze here feels incredible.
say:9:1320718006:1.source_cn: 啊……话说回来，这里的风，好舒服。
say:9:1320718006:1.male: Ah... the breeze here feels incredible.
say:9:1320718006:1.female: Ah... the breeze here feels incredible.

say:10:1320718007:1.text: You know, the first time I stumbled on this sea of flowers, I wanted to write you a letter describing how breathtaking it is.
say:10:1320718007:1.source_cn: 第一次看到这片花海时我就想写信给你，向你描述这片美景。
say:10:1320718007:1.male: You know, the first time I stumbled on this sea of flowers, I wanted to write you a letter describing how breathtaking it is.
say:10:1320718007:1.female: You know, the first time I stumbled on this sea of flowers, I wanted to write you a letter describing how breathtaking it is.

say:11:1320718008:1.text: But, well, for all my so-called eloquence, I just couldn't put it into words. So… I gave up.
say:11:1320718008:1.source_cn: 我自认为能说会道，却无法描绘出这份景色，最后只好放弃了！
say:11:1320718008:1.male: But, well, for all my so-called eloquence, I just couldn't put it into words. So… I gave up.
say:11:1320718008:1.female: But, well, for all my so-called eloquence, I just couldn't put it into words. So… I gave up.

say:12:1320718009:1.text: Some things, though, you have to see with your own eyes to really understand.
say:12:1320718009:1.source_cn: 有些景色，还是要亲眼所见才能感受它的美好。
say:12:1320718009:1.male: Some things, though, you have to see with your own eyes to really understand.
say:12:1320718009:1.female: Some things, though, you have to see with your own eyes to really understand.

say:13:1320718010:1.text: And the people you share those moments with? That's what makes them unforgettable.
say:13:1320718010:1.source_cn: 而且，一起看风景的人，也会影响欣赏风景的心情。
say:13:1320718010:1.male: And the people you share those moments with? That's what makes them unforgettable.
say:13:1320718010:1.female: And the people you share those moments with? That's what makes them unforgettable.

say:17:1320718016:1.text: You know what this moment needs? Music! You can't waste scenery this gorgeous without a tune.
say:17:1320718016:1.source_cn: 这时候得配上一点音乐，不能辜负了美景。
say:17:1320718016:1.male: You know what this moment needs? Music! You can't waste scenery this gorgeous without a tune.
say:17:1320718016:1.female: You know what this moment needs? Music! You can't waste scenery this gorgeous without a tune.

say:18:1320718017:1.source_cn: 我有些灵感，来，你坐在这里，坐好了。

say:19:1320718018:1.text: It's been a while since I've played, so if I mess up, no laughing, alright?
say:19:1320718018:1.source_cn: 有段时间没弹了，要是有些走调，你可不要笑我。
say:19:1320718018:1.male: It's been a while since I've played, so if I mess up, no laughing, alright?
say:19:1320718018:1.female: It's been a while since I've played, so if I mess up, no laughing, alright?

narration:26:1320718101:0.text: Lorsan gently strums his lute, and a peaceful melody flows through the sea of flowers.
narration:26:1320718101:0.source_cn: 洛桑轻轻拨动了琴弦，悠扬的旋律在盛开的花海间荡漾
narration:26:1320718101:0.male: Lorsan gently strums his lute, and a peaceful melody flows through the sea of flowers.
narration:26:1320718101:0.female: Lorsan gently strums his lute, and a peaceful melody flows through the sea of flowers.

narration:27:1320718102:0.text: You feel your body grow lighter, as though you've become one with the petals dancing freely in the wind.
narration:27:1320718102:0.source_cn: 你感到身体都变得轻盈了不少，如同随风飘扬的花瓣
narration:27:1320718102:0.male: You feel your body grow lighter, as though you've become one with the petals dancing freely in the wind.
narration:27:1320718102:0.female: You feel your body grow lighter, as though you've become one with the petals dancing freely in the wind.

narration:28:1320718103:0.text: Seeing how much you enjoy the melody, Lorsan smiles as well.
narration:28:1320718103:0.source_cn: 见你很喜欢这首曲子，洛桑也露出了笑容
narration:28:1320718103:0.male: Seeing how much you enjoy the melody, Lorsan smiles as well.
narration:28:1320718103:0.female: Seeing how much you enjoy the melody, Lorsan smiles as well.

say:33:1320718104:0.text: Before long, you'll be setting off on your next journey, and perhaps, with a little more saved, I'll leave this place too.
say:33:1320718104:0.source_cn: 不久之后，也许你又要踏上新的旅途，我再存一点旅费也会离...
say:33:1320718104:0.male: Before long, you'll be setting off on your next journey, and perhaps, with a little more saved, I'll leave this place too.
say:33:1320718104:0.female: Before long, you'll be setting off on your next journey, and perhaps, with a little more saved, I'll leave this place too.

say:34:1320718105:0.text: One day, if fate brings us together again somewhere in Esperia, I'll play this melody for you once more.
say:34:1320718105:0.source_cn: 某天，我们在伊索米亚的某个地方再度相遇时，我再为你弹奏...
say:34:1320718105:0.male: One day, if fate brings us together again somewhere in Esperia, I'll play this melody for you once more.
say:34:1320718105:0.female: One day, if fate brings us together again somewhere in Esperia, I'll play this melody for you once more.

say:35:1320718106:1.text: Alright, it's getting late. If we don't head back soon, Gerda's gonna think we got lost or something.
say:35:1320718106:1.source_cn: 好啦，时候不早了，再不回去的话，格尔达该着急了。
say:35:1320718106:1.male: Alright, it's getting late. If we don't head back soon, Gerda's gonna think we got lost or something.
say:35:1320718106:1.female: Alright, it's getting late. If we don't head back soon, Gerda's gonna think we got lost or something.

say:40:1320718109:1.text: Ahh! That melody must've attracted some monsters! Help!!
say:40:1320718109:1.source_cn: 噫！刚才的旋律把那些怪物引过来了！救救救救命！
say:40:1320718109:1.male: Ahh! That melody must've attracted some monsters! Help!!
say:40:1320718109:1.female: Ahh! That melody must've attracted some monsters! Help!!

narration:42:13020731:0.text: Admiring the beautiful scenery of the Petalia Plains, Lorsan is inspired and takes out his lute to play a wonderous piece of music for you.
narration:42:13020731:0.source_cn: 欣赏着繁花原野的美丽风景，洛桑灵感泉涌，拿出琴为你演奏...

narration:43:13020731:0.text: Admiring the beautiful scenery of the Petalia Plains, Lorsan is inspired and takes out his lute to play a wonderous piece of music for you.
narration:43:13020731:0.source_cn: 欣赏着繁花原野的美丽风景，洛桑灵感泉涌，拿出琴为你演奏...

say:44:1320718013:1.text: If only we hadn't cracked open that can of fish...
say:44:1320718013:1.source_cn: 要是没打开过那个鱼罐头就好了……
say:44:1320718013:1.male: If only we hadn't cracked open that can of fish...
say:44:1320718013:1.female: If only we hadn't cracked open that can of fish...

say:45:1320718014:1.text: But then... I wouldn't be here with you.
say:45:1320718014:1.source_cn: 但那样的话，我可能也不会和你一起到这里来。
say:45:1320718014:1.male: But then... I wouldn't be here with you.
say:45:1320718014:1.female: But then... I wouldn't be here with you.

say:46:1320718015:1.text: Guess I should be thanking the fish for this moment.
say:46:1320718015:1.male: Guess I should be thanking the fish for this moment.
say:46:1320718015:1.female: Guess I should be thanking the fish for this moment.

say:47:1320718005:1.text: Hey! Master Arden says true genius can sometimes look foolish. Who's to say I'm not secretly a genius?
say:47:1320718005:1.source_cn: 雅顿老爷子常说，聪明到了极致便显得有些愚蠢，说不定我也...
say:47:1320718005:1.male: Hey! Master Arden says true genius can sometimes look foolish. Who's to say I'm not secretly a genius?
say:47:1320718005:1.female: Hey! Master Arden says true genius can sometimes look foolish. Who's to say I'm not secretly a genius?

narration:48:13020731:0.text: Admiring the beautiful scenery of the Petalia Plains, Lorsan is inspired and takes out his lute to play a wonderous piece of music for you.
narration:48:13020731:0.source_cn: 欣赏着繁花原野的美丽风景，洛桑灵感泉涌，拿出琴为你演奏...

say:1:1320741001:1.text: Bavier, are you ready? You're about to go on a journey just like the one I took once.
say:1:1320741001:1.source_cn: 巴维尔，准备好了吗？你将亲自体验我经历过的旅途。

say:3:1320741003:1.text: Oh, it's true! Watch this. With these crystals arranged just right, and a simple metal spoon—
say:3:1320741003:1.source_cn: 我可没骗你。只要把这些大小不一的冰晶石依次摆放，再拿一...

say:10:1320742001:2.text: Wow... Amazing! The melody, it's like I'm seeing pictures!
say:10:1320742001:2.source_cn: 好、好神奇！只是听着旋律，好像能感受到画面！

say:11:1320742002:1.text: I can almost make out white birds soaring, antelopes racing across the desert... animals I've only dreamed of.
say:11:1320742002:1.source_cn: 我好像看见了挥动翅膀的白鸟，在沙漠里奔跑的羚羊……看见...

say:13:1320742004:1.text: I wanna reach out to them, to be near them.
say:13:1320742004:1.source_cn: 我想摸摸他们……想到他们身边去。

say:14:1320742005:1.text: And you can totally do that! But first, you have to focus on your treatment. How will you recover if you don't even take the medicine the doctor gives you?
say:14:1320742005:1.source_cn: 巴维尔……你可以的！但是你要安心治疗，如果连医生给的药...

say:15:1320742006:1.text: Do you really think I can? They say this kind of illness is almost impossible to cure... I'm already blind...
say:15:1320742006:1.source_cn: 我真的能恢复吗……我听说，这种病很难恢复……我已经瞎了。

say:16:1320742007:1.text: But you can see right now, can't you? What determines how you view the world isn't your eyes—it's your heart.
say:16:1320742007:1.source_cn: 你现在也能看见，不是吗？决定你能否看见风景的，不是你的...

say:17:1320742008:1.text: Trust in it, Bavier. Believe in yourself, and one day, I know you'll go on adventures again.
say:17:1320742008:1.source_cn: 用你的心，相信你的眼睛。你一定可以再次踏上冒险的旅途。

say:19:1320742010:1.text: I understand. I'll try to trust it!
say:19:1320742010:1.source_cn: 我知道了，我会试着相信它！

say:21:1320742012:1.text: U-Uncle?! Whoa, whoa, I'm not that old, kiddo! Anyway, we'll totally go adventuring together once you're better. But first, you have to get well, alright?
say:21:1320742012:1.source_cn: 等你康复了，说不定我们还有机会一起去冒险呢，一定要好起来啊。

narration:23:1320742014:1.text: Over the next few days, Lorsan plays enchanting melodies with the luminite—a quirky, yet ingenious creation only he could dream up.

narration:26:13020760:0.text: Using seven ice spikes of different lengths and a spoon, Lorsan plays a lively tune for Bavier.
